patch_description: Replace the current over-parameterized ansatz block with a compact, symmetry-aware block that restores the parameter-efficient motif which previously produced stronger validation/test performance. The new block reduces per-block parameters by sharing rotations across corner/edge/center symmetry zones, compresses repeating CRZ couplings (ring vs center), aligns ZZZ three-body rotations exactly with the eight winning lines (rows, columns, diagonals) and groups CCRZ triples by geometric symmetry. Final local rotations are tied per symmetry zone (RZ+RX sharing a single key). This reduces N_PARAMS while keeping expressive three-body motifs targeted to the tic-tac-toe winning lines, improving parameter efficiency and generalization.
